config.autoConnect.title: Autoconnect on USB
config.autoConnect.description: Automatically connects to the first detected MicroPython board. A port set in Manual COM device is always used instead.
config.manualComDevice.title: Manual COM device
config.manualComDevice.description: Serial port to always connect to, e.g. COM3 or /dev/ttyACM0. Works with any board, also ones that aren't detected automatically. Leave empty to detect boards automatically. Switch Board lets you pick the port from a list.
config.customVidPidPairs.title: Custom VID/PID pairs
config.customVidPidPairs.markdownDescrip: Additional USB Vendor ID (VID) and Product ID (PID) pairs to recognize as MicroPython boards. Useful for boards with custom USB-to-serial adapters not in the built-in list. Enter values in **decimal** format (e.g., `{"vid": 1027, "pid": 24592}` for FTDI FT2232H with VID 0x0403 and PID 0x6010).
config.syncFolder.title: Sync Folder
config.syncFolder.description: This folder will be uploaded to the board when using the sync button. Leave empty to sync the complete project. (only allows folders within the project). Use a path relative to the project you opened in VS Code, without leading or trailing slash
config.additionalSyncFolders.title: Additional Sync Folders
config.additionalSyncFolders.description: Specifies additional folders that can be selected as upload sources when uploading a project. If left empty, the sync will be performed based on the folder specified in the 'syncFolder' setting. Only folders within the project are allowed. Specify the path relative to the project you have opened in Visual Studio Code, without a leading or trailing slash.
config.syncAllFileTypes.title: Upload all file types
config.syncAllFileTypes.description: If enabled, all files will be uploaded no matter the file type. The list of file types below will be ignored
config.syncFileTypes.title: Upload file types
config.syncFileTypes.description: All types of files that will be uploaded to the board, separated by comma. All other filetypes will be ignored during an upload (or download) action
config.pyIgnore.title: Pyignore list
config.pyIgnore.markdownDescription: Comma separated list of files and folders to ignore when uploading relative to syncFolder (no wildcard or regular expressions supported except `**/<file/folder>` to exclude an item by its name in every sub folder). Use `<additionalSyncFolder>:file/to/exclude.py` to create sync folder exclusive exclusion rules (all other rules will always be applied relative to the selected sync folder). Replace `additionalSyncFolder` with a value from your `micropico.additionalSyncFolders` setting or the value from `micropico.syncFolder`.
config.openOnStart.title: Open on start
config.openOnStart.description: Automatically open the MicroPico vREPL after starting VS Code. Could cause random terminal freezes on Linux.
config.statusbarButtons.title: Statusbar buttons
config.statusbarButtons.description: Select which buttons to show in the statusbar
config.gcBeforeUpload.title: Garbage collection before upload
config.gcBeforeUpload.description: Run garbage collection before uploading files to the board. This frees up memory, which helps when uploading large files, but adds a second or two to the upload.
config.softResetAfterUpload.title: Soft-reset after upload
config.softResetAfterUpload.description: Soft-resets your board after any upload action, which also reruns main.py and boot.py. Useful when working with main.py and boot.py.
config.executeOnConnect.title: Script to execute on connect
config.executeOnConnect.description: Path to a MicroPython script on the board to execute on connect. Leave empty to disable.
config.importOnConnect.title: MicroPython module to import on connect
config.importOnConnect.description: A MicroPython module to import in vREPL on connect. Leave empty to disable.
config.noSoftResetOnRun.title: Disable the soft reset before running a file.
config.noSoftResetOnRun.description: The soft reset clears the REPL state so changes to classes and other structures take effect. Programs keep running after the file finished, e.g. timers.
config.disableRunFileTypeWarning.title: Disable the warning when running a non-Python file.
config.disableRunFileTypeWarning.descrip: When enabled, running a file that is not a `.py` or `.mpy` file no longer prompts for confirmation.
config.alwaysStopRunningProgram.title: Always stop a running program
config.alwaysStopRunningProgram.descript: Stop a program still running on the board without asking before uploading, downloading or resetting.
